verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo, headline, subtitle and CTA order intact and the RSVP button stays prominent. But the three pills are scattered: TASTINGS floats beside the date, and FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES are split far apart. The legal text is jammed against the URL line at the bottom edge, and the lower-left cluster is cramped. B makes the headline dominant, but the CTA is buried: RSVP Free is shrunk to the same size as the FREE ENTRY badge and mixed in with the badges. The subtitle and date are squeezed into a narrow column with awkward wrapping. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is shrunk to illegibility and floats apart from the headline. The 'Reserve a spot' line is detached from its button, so the reading order is jumbled.
